name: Independence Blue Cross

internationalCoverage.overview: Independence Blue Cross (IBX) serves southeastern Pennsylvania and is a BCBS licensee. IBX provides international coverage through BCBS Global Core and also partners with GeoBlue for supplemental international health plans. This makes IBX members well-positioned for international travel.

planDifferences.description: PPO plans (Personal Choice) provide international emergency and urgent care through Global Core. HMO (Keystone) plans cover international emergencies only. IBX also offers GeoBlue international plans as add-ons for frequent travelers.

covered: Emergency care via BCBS Global Core
GeoBlue supplemental plans available for purchase

alerts.title: GeoBlue Partnership
alerts.message: IBX is one of the few BCBS licensees that actively promotes GeoBlue international plans. If you travel frequently, ask IBX about adding GeoBlue — it provides comprehensive international coverage including medical evacuation and routine care abroad.

alerts.title: Global Core Access
alerts.message: Standard IBX plans use BCBS Global Core for international coverage. Call 1-800-810-BLUE for assistance abroad.

supplementalInsurance.details: Recommended but less urgent if you add GeoBlue. IBX members have the advantage of easy access to GeoBlue supplemental plans, which are among the best international health coverage options available.

questionsToAsk: Does my IBX plan include BCBS Global Core access?
Is GeoBlue coverage included in my plan or available as an add-on?
What's the cost to add GeoBlue international coverage?
Does my plan cover medical evacuation?
